verdicts.reason: A breaks the brand lockup: the gold leaf wreath has been pulled away to the far left edge as an empty, meaningless ring, while 'Perfect Taste' floats alone in the middle, small and unframed. B keeps the wreath around the title as in the original. Its problems are that the title is small for the banner, crowded inside the wreath and sits partly over the busy fig imagery, and the crop drops most of the dessert, so the right half is an unclear close-up of fruit.
